items.title: How Hard Was It To Hold Motorola Solutions Stock?
items.summary: A $10,000 stake in Motorola Solutions stock in November 2016 was worth $66,137 at Wednesday's close, before dividends. The same money in the S&P 500 grew to $32,943, also before dividends. On a chart, that gain looks easy to hold. It was not. How many times do you think the stock fell 20% or more along the way.

items.title: Are You Overpaying For Axon Stock Versus Its Peers?
items.summary: Axon Enterprise makes Taser devices and police body cameras, and sells the software behind them. In its Trefis peer group of four companies, it has the highest price for its profit and the thinnest operating margin. Is that price right for what Axon delivers today.
